items.title: What the Numbers Tell About FedEx Freight (FDXF) Following Spin-Off

items.title: Tesla’s Electric Semi Could Win From High Diesel Prices
items.summary: Electric, autonomously driven big rigs are one solution to the shipping industry’s current diesel problem.  A gallon of diesel fuel is around $6, nearly double the year-ago level.  Crude oil prices aren’t up that much, but the fighting has taken so-called heavier crude off the market, which yields more diesel fuel per barrel, all else being equal.

items.title: Surging Diesel Costs Beat Down Freight Stocks—Creating a Buy Opportunity
items.summary: XPO, Saia, Knight-Swift, and Paccar could benefit as tightening trucking capacity and improving freight rates outweigh the hit from soaring diesel prices.

items.title: JPMorgan starts FedEx Freight at Overweight on post-spin turnaround
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Tuesday, JPMorgan initiated coverage of FedEx Freight with an Overweight rating and a December 2027 price target of $160, arguing the recent spin-off gives North America's largest less-than-truckload carrier room to improve profitability and service as a stand-alone company.

items.title: FedEx Freight says executive terminated over code of conduct violation
items.summary: The LTL carrier will spread the responsibilities of former EVP Michael Lyons to other company executives, according to a regulatory filing.

items.title: FedEx Freight fires chief commercial officer following internal probe
items.summary: FedEx Freight announced that it has terminated Chief Specialized Services and Commercial Officer Mike Lyons, who was appointed to the role ahead of the company’s spinoff from FedEx Corp.
